subject: Planned third‑party role bindings & dataflow delegation — advance notice
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Smith <john.smith@goldcap.com>, security@goldcap.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Planned third‑party role bindings & dataflow delegation — advance notice

Hi John / GoldCap security team,

Quick heads up from Redwood: next week (Aug 24–25) we plan a small operational change that affects how a subset of our operator accounts are bound to cluster roles in the eu-west and us-west regions. This is part of a scheduled handover where one vendor operator (EdgeOps Ltd.) will be replaced with our new managed partner (SignalMesh) for telemetry aggregation and node maintenance.

Why we are telling you now:
- We know GoldCap requires advance notice for any changes that could affect operator-level access or dataflow topology.
- The change is scoped: it only touches the operator role bindings used by background telemetry and node health probes, not customer data plane routing or model artifacts.

What's included in this notice (attached):
- operator_roster_20260817.csv — list of operator accounts and their new owner
- k8s_role-delegation.yaml — the exact RBAC patch we'll apply (clusterRoleBinding diffs)
- service_dependency_map_v1.pdf — a diagram of impacted services and dataflows

Planned timeline:
- Aug 24 01:00–03:00 UTC — apply rolebinding changes in us-west cluster pool (rolling)
- Aug 24 04:00–06:00 UTC — smoke tests and log verification
- Aug 25 01:00–03:00 UTC — apply to eu-west pool (rolling)

Rollback and controls:
- We will not change any secrets or KMS policies as part of this action.
- Immediate rollback script included in k8s_role-delegation.yaml (annotation + reversal job).
- Audit trail: we will provide the full Cloud Audit Logs slice for the operation window within 24 hours.

Ask from GoldCap: please confirm whether you want us to open a formal change ticket with your SRE team (preferred) or if an email-and-attachments notice is sufficient. If you'd like a timeboxed call to walk through the diffs, we're available Aug 20–21 between 14:00–17:00 PST.

Thanks — we want this to be as transparent as possible.

—
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: operator_roster_20260817.csv (csv), k8s_role-delegation.yaml (text), service_dependency_map_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: John Smith <john.smith@goldcap.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, security@goldcap.com
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planned third‑party role bindings & dataflow delegation — advance notice

Monica — thanks for the heads up. A couple quick questions before we sign off: 

1) Scope: you say "background telemetry and node health probes" — can you confirm no customer tokens, embeddings, or inference request paths will be touched? Explicitly: will any IAM principals that can access model artifacts or S3 (our bucket) be modified?
2) Identity: does SignalMesh have a SOC2 Type II report we can review, or at minimum an AICPA/third‑party attestation?
3) Rollback SLA: if the operation causes a 5xx spike we want guaranteed rollback within 30 minutes — is that supported?

Also please provide a copy of the audit logs for a dry‑run once you apply the change in the staging cluster.

John Smith
Head of Infrastructure Security, GoldCap Financial
john.smith@goldcap.com

On Mon, 17 Aug 2026 at 09:12, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Quick heads up from Redwood: next week (Aug 24–25) we plan a small operational change...

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Smith <john.smith@goldcap.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, security@goldcap.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planned third‑party role bindings & dataflow delegation — advance notice

John — thanks for the precise questions. Short answers up front, with evidence pointers below: 

1) Scope: Confirmed — no principals with access to customer S3 buckets, model artifact registries, or inference runtimes are being changed. The operator accounts are limited to node agent roles (read-only metrics, health reporting, limited exec for troubleshooting). See column "access_scope" in operator_roster_20260817.csv for the ACLs.

2) SignalMesh attestations: SignalMesh provided their SOC2 Type II summary and a vendor checklist last week; I attached the redacted summary to our internal drive link and included the vendor reference ID in the HubSpot deal. If you'd like the full report under an NDA, we can expedite.

3) Rollback SLA: We will run the rolebinding change as a canary (5% node subset) and hold for 15 minutes of telemetry. If error rates exceed our thresholds we will auto-trigger the reversal job. For worst‑case manual rollback we commit to a 30 minute RTO for the clusters in scope; runbook and contact list included in the doc.

Deliverables we will provide during the window:
- Live Cloud Audit Logs slice for the operation window (within 24 hrs)
- K8s event stream and our alert snapshots
- Post‑change RCA if any anomalies

Next steps: Monica — can you schedule the 30‑minute walkthrough with GoldCap security (John) on Aug 20 at 15:00 PST? Rishi / Karthik — please prepare the staging dry‑run and collect logs to send after the canary.

—
Kimberly Park
Product Security Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Smith <john.smith@goldcap.com>, security@goldcap.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planned third‑party role bindings & dataflow delegation — advance notice

Thanks everyone — confirmed for the walkthrough.

Call scheduled:
- Aug 20, 2026 15:00 PST / 22:00 UTC — 30 minutes (meet link in related_links)

Pre-read packet (attached + drive):
- operator_roster_20260817.csv — CSV with access_scope and vendor_owner columns
- k8s_role-delegation.yaml — patch + rollback job (annotated)
- service_dependency_map_v1.pdf — diagram and impact legend
- Staging dry‑run logs (will be provided after the canary on Aug 24)

If GoldCap wants the full SignalMesh SOC2 under NDA, please loop your legal contact and we will share via the DocuSign/NDA link in related_links.

If there are any objections to the change window we will postpone until after a joint SRE review. Otherwise we will proceed with the canary on Aug 24 as described.

—
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: operator_roster_20260817.csv, k8s_role-delegation.yaml, service_dependency_map_v1.pdf
